title: lint: the measure-aggregate-field-type-refused hint for a formula total says "aggregate it with count", where the spec's own remedy is "store the value as a number field" (cloud#2861 ruling B item 4)
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`), as objectstack-ai/cloud#2861's ruling B item 4 binds (`6257959910`). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What the lint says today

At cloud's framework pin `ec749fbb`, `packages/lint/src/validate-dataset-measure-aggregates.ts:436-446` handles a dataset measure `sum` / `avg` / `min` / `max` over a `formula` field. It refuses it (`measure-aggregate-field-type-refused`), with this hint:

> Either point "sum" at a field of an accepted type, or aggregate "leave_days" with one its formula type accepts: count, count_distinct.

So the hint steers an author toward a COUNT. That is the very substitution cloud#2861 measured as a plausible wrong number: 「Total Leave Days」 showed 3 records against a true total of 10 days.

## What the spec says

The spec's own remedy is the semantic migration `18.dataset-measure-aggregate-field-type-refused` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/`): store the value as a number field and aggregate that. The compile leg already says it (`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-compiler.ts:289-290`: "a quantity that should be added up has to be stored as a numeric field and aggregated as one").

## Target

- For a total (`sum` / `avg` / `min` / `max`) over a formula, or another class the table refuses because it is virtual, the hint names the spec's remedy first: store the value as a number field and aggregate that.
- A count or count-distinct stays named, but only as a different question ("how many records"), not as the way to get the total.
- The compile leg and the lint read the same sentence: one source, not two drifting copies.

## Acceptance

A lint test: a `sum` over a formula field yields the hint naming the stored-number remedy. The `count_distinct` × JSON-list case keeps its own hint.

Related: objectstack-ai/cloud#2861 (ruling B), objectstack-ai/objectstack#24425 (the published skills teach the same rule).

Dedupe words: measure-aggregate-field-type-refused hint, formula total count hint, store as number field remedy, aggregate field type lint hint.
